words.definition: a present-perfect-continuous frame used to talk about an action or state that started in the past and continues up to now
words.translation: 我一直在……（表示從過去持續到現在的動作或狀態）
words.example: I have been thinking about this a lot lately.
words.exampleTranslation: 我最近一直在思考這件事。
words.note: 後面接現在分詞（動詞-ing），例如 I have been working here for five years，強調動作持續進行

words.definition: describes something that is understood or felt but not said out loud
words.translation: 心照不宣地未說出口；未明說的
words.example: There was a mutual respect between them that was left unspoken.
words.exampleTranslation: 他們之間有一種未曾明說、卻心照不宣的相互尊重。
words.note: 常見句型 be left unspoken，強調「刻意或自然地沒有說出來」

words.definition: used to introduce more precise or detailed information about something just mentioned
words.example: I'd like some feedback on the report — to be specific, on the conclusion section.
words.exampleTranslation: 我想聽聽對這份報告的意見——具體來說，是結論的部分。
words.note: 常放在句首或句中補充細節，語氣比 specifically 稍微口語一點

words.definition: in agreement with someone, or having the same understanding of a situation
words.example: Let's have a quick call to make sure we're on the same page before the presentation.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們在簡報之前先通個電話，確認大家想法一致。
words.note: 常搭配 make sure / get everyone 使用，例如 get everyone on the same page（讓大家達成共識）

words.definition: functions effectively or is suitable for a particular purpose or person
words.example: This schedule works well for me — how about you?
words.exampleTranslation: 這個時間安排對我來說很合適，你呢？
words.note: 常見用法 works well for + 人，表示「對某人而言是合適的」

words.definition: to proceed with a plan, project, or decision after a pause or discussion
words.example: We've reviewed all the feedback, so let's move forward with the final design.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們已經檢視過所有意見了，就讓我們繼續推進最終設計吧。
words.note: 職場會議中常用，等同於 proceed 或 go ahead，語氣較積極正面

words.definition: existing or available in the world in general; also used informally to describe something unusual or bold
words.translation: 在外面的世界；存在著（也可指「很特別／很誇張」）
words.example: There are so many good restaurants out there — we just haven't tried them yet.
words.exampleTranslation: 外面有這麼多好餐廳，我們只是還沒試過而已。
words.note: 也可用來形容人事物很奇特，例如 That idea is a bit out there（那個想法有點誇張／不切實際）

words.definition: a method of solving a problem by trying different approaches and learning from mistakes until finding what works
words.example: I learned how to bake bread through a lot of trial and error.
words.exampleTranslation: 我是靠反覆試驗才學會怎麼烤麵包的。
words.note: 常搭配介系詞 by 或 through，例如 by trial and error

words.definition: an adjective describing someone or something that is reliably turned to first for help or as the best option
words.example: She's my go-to person whenever I have a technical problem.
words.exampleTranslation: 每次我有技術問題，她都是我第一個想到要找的人。
words.note: 常用於 go-to person / go-to place / go-to app 等複合名詞，帶有「最信賴、最常用」的意思

words.form: I have no choice but to
words.definition: used to say that someone is forced to do something because there is no other option
words.example: The flight was cancelled, so I had no choice but to book another one.
words.exampleTranslation: 班機被取消了，我別無選擇，只能另外訂一班。
words.note: but to 後面接原形動詞，例如 no choice but to leave

words.definition: used to say that the right or appropriate moment has come to do something
words.example: It's time to wrap up the meeting and get back to work.
words.exampleTranslation: 是時候該結束會議、回去工作了。
words.note: 後面接原形動詞；也可說 it's time for + 名詞，例如 it's time for a break

words.definition: used before restating or confirming something to make sure it is correctly understood
words.translation: 只是想確認一下；澄清一下
words.example: Just to clarify, the deadline is Friday, not next Monday, right?
words.exampleTranslation: 只是想確認一下，截止日期是星期五，不是下週一，對嗎？
words.note: 常放在句首，語氣禮貌，用來避免誤會

words.definition: to ask someone to explain or demonstrate something step by step
words.translation: 帶我一步步了解；跟我說明整個流程
words.example: Could you walk me through how this new system works?
words.exampleTranslation: 可以請你跟我一步步說明這個新系統是怎麼運作的嗎？
words.note: 也可用 walk somebody through something 的句型，例如 Let me walk you through the process

words.definition: used to accept a situation as unchangeable, even if it is not ideal
words.translation: 事情就是這樣；沒辦法改變的事實
words.example: I wish the office hours were more flexible, but it's the way it is.
words.exampleTranslation: 我希望上班時間可以更彈性一點，但事情就是這樣了。
words.note: 帶有無奈接受現況的語氣，類似 that's just how it is

words.definition: to think of or produce an idea, plan, or solution
words.translation: 想出；提出（點子、計畫、解決方案）
words.example: We need to come up with a better solution before the client meeting.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們得在跟客戶開會之前想出一個更好的解決方案。
words.note: 後面直接接名詞，例如 come up with an idea/plan/excuse

words.definition: used to reassure someone that others share the same feeling or experience
words.translation: 你並不孤單；不是只有你這樣
words.example: If you're feeling overwhelmed by this project, you are not alone — the whole team feels the same way.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果你覺得這個專案讓你喘不過氣，你並不孤單——整個團隊都有同樣的感覺。
words.note: 常用於安慰或鼓勵他人的情境

words.definition: busy and constantly active, often doing something while moving or between tasks
words.example: I usually grab a coffee on the go before heading into the office.
words.exampleTranslation: 我通常在進辦公室之前，會邊走邊買一杯咖啡。
words.note: 常搭配飲食或攜帶物品，例如 a snack on the go（可以邊走邊吃的點心）

words.definition: did something correctly, especially after one or more attempts
words.example: After three attempts, she finally got it right.
words.exampleTranslation: 試了三次之後，她終於做對了。
words.note: get it right 的過去式；也常用祈使句 Let's get it right this time

words.definition: used to check whether the listener understands or finds something logical
words.translation: 這樣說得通嗎？你聽懂了嗎？
words.example: I've explained the process step by step — does it make sense so far?
words.exampleTranslation: 我已經一步步說明過整個流程了，到目前為止你都聽懂了嗎？
words.note: 常用於說明或解釋之後，確認對方是否理解

words.definition: used to apologize for doing something unintentionally
words.example: I didn't mean to interrupt you — please continue.
words.exampleTranslation: 我不是故意要打斷你的，請繼續說。
words.note: 後面常接原形動詞，例如 I didn't mean to hurt your feelings
